# netcup_server_gpu_driver (Ephemeral Resource)

The download of the GPU driver of a netcup server (SCP REST API). It needs Terraform 1.10 or newer. netcup answers with an error if the server has none.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "netcup_server_gpu_driver" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String) Name of the file.
- `headers` (Map of List of String, Sensitive) Headers to send with the download.
- `presigned_url` (String, Sensitive) Download URL.
- `presigned_url_validity_duration_in_hours` (Number) Validity of the URL in hours.
